Audio fixtures for QA.
- `silence.wav`: 0.5 s of silence, used by the mock smoke test (transcript comes from `debug_transcript`).
- For cloud QA add TTS-generated (own, licensed) recordings named `<phrase-id>.wav`, e.g. `can-i-have.wav`,
  plus intentionally wrong variants (`can-i-have.bad.wav`) to calibrate thresholds.
